observations.label: B1
observations.prompt: Different prompt: 'First do X. Then do Y. Document: <head 100 lines>'

usage.note: Different user prompt; cache_read hit 36670 anyway. This corresponds to Claude Code's internal system+tools bundle, not user-prompt content.

hypothesis_validated: cache_read on claude-cli reflects Claude Code's PLATFORM-LEVEL system+tools prefix only. User-prompt content does not cache cross-invocation through `claude -p`. The ~36K-token cache_read in B1 is a fixed platform freebie, not a workload-specific savings.
implication_for_summary_doctor: Running summary-doctor twice with the same source via the claude-cli backend does NOT produce user-prompt cache reuse. The ~36K platform cache_read is the same whether you re-audit or not.
implication_for_v0_2_2_spec: Spec §3.6 'claude-cli auto caches cross-invocation' framing is falsified for user-prompt content. Rev 3 will distinguish platform-level (auto, always-on, unrelated to summary-doctor) from prompt-level (only via Anthropic SDK + explicit cache_control, not via claude-cli).
